cause: FileUtils.correctFileNumbers used provider display basename as unique map key and REPLACE_EXISTING; several HTML IDs for one name selected the last enumerated ID, overwriting distinct CSV/TXT histories. Reproduced on isolated copies by startup_audit.
fix: Only bijective basename-to-ID and ID-to-basename HTML filename mappings are eligible.
Multiple per-type CSV/TXT candidates sharing basename are preserved.
Existing target is blocked; Files.move without replacement also protects a concurrently created target.
backup_policy: New distinct backup; earlier before_archive_fx_goal backup preserved. No app/UI/server restart.

independent_review.scope: Read-only FileUtils and7 new tests. Confirmed reproduced same-name/multiple-ID overwrite is prevented. Existing unique-basename wrong-ID correction policy still uses filenames, not CSV content identity; unchanged by this fix.
